items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I got Louis, to come over to the Orchard. And that was just the next night, we had to open at the Orchard. And I got old Louis and Johnny St. Cyr and Yudell Wilson. And we opened up.

ctx.x: Yes, was with us, yes. He invited the three of us. Yes, but ...............
